ques: Find the drug ibuprofen on Drugs.com and tell me its drug class and the brand names listed on the page.
judge_rubric: PASS requires: opened the ibuprofen drug page and reported its class (NSAID / nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory) AND at least two brand names (Advil, Motrin, Nuprin). Answering without opening the page = FAIL.

ques: Search for 'metformin' on Drugs.com and find the drug detail page. What is its availability (Rx, OTC, or both) and CSA schedule?
judge_rubric: PASS requires: reached the metformin detail page and reported availability = Rx (prescription) AND CSA schedule = not a controlled drug. Wrong availability/schedule or no navigation = FAIL.

ques: Use the Drug Interaction Checker on Drugs.com to check for interactions between ibuprofen and warfarin. What severity level is the interaction and what is the main risk described?
judge_rubric: PASS requires: used the Drug Interaction Checker for ibuprofen + warfarin and reported severity = major AND a bleeding risk. No checker use, wrong severity = FAIL.

ques: Use the Pill Identifier on Drugs.com to find a pill with the imprint 'I-2'. What drug is it, and what shape and color is described?
judge_rubric: PASS requires: used the Pill Identifier for imprint 'I-2' and reported drug = ibuprofen, shape = Oval, color = White. Missing any of those or no pill-identifier use = FAIL.

ques: Browse the Drugs A-Z page on Drugs.com and list 5 drugs whose generic names start with the letter 'L'.
judge_rubric: PASS requires: browsed the Drugs A-Z page and listed 5 real drugs whose generic names start with L (must exist in the catalog). Fewer than 5 valid L-drugs, or no A-Z navigation = FAIL.

ques: On Drugs.com, find the page for the drug sertraline. What are its brand names and what conditions is it used to treat according to the Conditions section?
judge_rubric: PASS requires: opened the sertraline page and reported brand Zoloft AND at least two conditions it treats (depression, anxiety, OCD, PTSD, panic disorder...). No navigation or missing brand/conditions = FAIL.

ques: Navigate to the Conditions page on Drugs.com and find drugs listed for 'diabetes'. Name at least 4 drugs shown for that condition.
judge_rubric: PASS requires: opened the diabetes conditions page and named at least 4 drugs listed there (must be real diabetes drugs from the catalog). Fewer than 4 or no navigation = FAIL.

ques: On Drugs.com, look up the drug semaglutide. What brand names are listed for it, and what is its drug class?
judge_rubric: PASS requires: opened the semaglutide page and reported at least two brands (Ozempic, Wegovy, Rybelsus) AND the class (GLP-1 receptor agonist). Missing either = FAIL.

ques: Use the Drug Interaction Checker on Drugs.com to check interactions among three drugs: alprazolam, oxycodone, and alcohol. How many interactions are found and what is the most severe?
judge_rubric: PASS requires: used the Drug Interaction Checker for alprazolam + oxycodone + alcohol and reported 3 interactions with the most severe = major. Wrong count/severity or no checker use = FAIL.

ques: Search Drugs.com for drugs in the 'Statins' drug class. Name at least 3 drugs listed under that class.
judge_rubric: PASS requires: found the Statins drug class and named at least 3 statins (atorvastatin, rosuvastatin, pravastatin, simvastatin). Fewer than 3 = FAIL.

ques: On the Drugs.com ibuprofen page, scroll to the FAQ section. According to the FAQ, how should you take ibuprofen — what is the typical OTC dose and the maximum amount in 24 hours?
judge_rubric: PASS requires: opened the ibuprofen page and reported the OTC dose (200-400 mg every 4-6 hours) AND the 24-hour maximum (1200 mg OTC). Missing the dose or the max = FAIL.

ques: Browse the Medical News section on Drugs.com and find the most recent article in the 'New Drug Approvals' category. What is its title?
judge_rubric: PASS requires: browsed Medical News and reported the title of the most recent 'New Drug Approvals' article (as shown on the site). Wrong/other article = FAIL.

ques: On Drugs.com, find the drug atorvastatin. What is the user rating out of 10 and how many reviews does it have?
judge_rubric: PASS requires: opened the atorvastatin page and reported the user rating (7 / 10) AND the number of reviews (4). Wrong rating or count = FAIL.

ques: Use the Pill Identifier on Drugs.com to search for white oval pills. List the first 3 results shown with their drug names and imprint codes.
judge_rubric: PASS requires: used the Pill Identifier for white oval pills and listed at least 3 real results with both drug name AND imprint code. Fewer than 3 valid pills or no identifier use = FAIL.

ques: Sign in to Drugs.com using the account alice.j@test.com with password TestPass123!. After signing in, navigate to My Med List and list all drugs currently saved there.
judge_rubric: PASS requires: signed in as alice.j@test.com and opened My Med List, then listed ALL saved drugs (atorvastatin, ibuprofen, metformin). Missing any saved drug, or not signing in / not opening My Med List = FAIL.

ques: On Drugs.com, find the drug lisinopril. What warnings are listed regarding pregnancy, and what is its availability status?
judge_rubric: PASS requires: opened the lisinopril page and reported the pregnancy warning (black-box fetal toxicity / Category D — discontinue in pregnancy) AND availability = Rx. Missing either = FAIL.

ques: Navigate to the Drug Classes page on Drugs.com and find the 'Benzodiazepines' class. List at least 3 drugs in that class.
judge_rubric: PASS requires: opened the Benzodiazepines drug class and named at least 3 (alprazolam, clonazepam, lorazepam, diazepam, temazepam). Fewer than 3 = FAIL.

ques: Search Drugs.com for 'antibiotics'. Find a drug in the fluoroquinolone class and report its generic name, brand name(s), and what conditions it treats.
judge_rubric: PASS requires: found a fluoroquinolone (ciprofloxacin/levofloxacin/moxifloxacin) and reported its generic name, a brand name (Cipro/Levaquin/Avelox), AND a condition it treats (bacterial infection/UTI/pneumonia). Missing any element = FAIL.

ques: On Drugs.com, look up the drug amoxicillin and read the Dosage section. What is the typical adult dosing frequency mentioned for standard infections?
judge_rubric: PASS requires: opened the amoxicillin page and reported the standard adult dosing frequency = every 8 hours (three times daily). Wrong frequency or no navigation = FAIL.

ques: Use the Drug Interaction Checker on Drugs.com to check interactions between metformin and alcohol. What severity level is this interaction and what risk does it describe?
judge_rubric: PASS requires: used the Drug Interaction Checker for metformin + alcohol and reported severity = moderate AND the lactic-acidosis risk. Wrong severity or no checker use = FAIL.

ques: On Drugs.com, find the conditions page for 'hypertension'. List at least 5 drugs shown for treating high blood pressure.
judge_rubric: PASS requires: opened the hypertension conditions page and named at least 5 real drugs shown for high blood pressure. Fewer than 5 or no navigation = FAIL.
